title: P01 pp5-9 source-gap closure is bounded to 21 registered gaps
claim: The accepted P01 supplement closes all 21 previously registered source-gap IDs for printed pages 5–9: 20 receive new source-first supplement records and one is already covered by canonical P02-200. It adds 77 atomic records (64 reusable projection rules and 13 CASE_SUPPORT_ONLY records), bringing cumulative P01 canonical records to 277 (213 reusable and 64 case-support-only). The artifact explicitly does not claim that every possible claim on those pages has been independently re-extracted beyond the registered gaps.
maturity_note: Accepted main commit 9735cd7a78a3c0addcf93aad1730d775e691be40 merges Product-independent Knowledge source-gap closure via PR #577. The final-head quality gate passed as recorded by that PR; no checks were rerun by this Sidecar task.
wording_ceiling: Say 'the 21 registered P01 source gaps on printed pp5-9 were dispositioned, with 77 source-bounded supplement records'; do not claim complete extraction of all content on pp5-9 or completion of the entire P01 corpus.
